infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: AI Javier Coach connects to Mentra Live over Bluetooth to record your workout sets.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Curl Vision Foundry uses the front camera to capture exercise videos for your personal coach dataset.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: AI Javier Coach can send Mentra Live recordings to your private workout processing service.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AI Javier Coach uses microphone access only for supported Mentra Live voice features; workout video capture is muted.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Curl Vision Foundry reads HeyCyan/BV100 workout videos from Photos and saves labeled clips for your personal coach dataset.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Curl Vision Foundry saves labeled exercise clips to your photo library.
